title: Evaluating SAE Reconstruction Error as a Proxy for Interpretability Completeness
original_idea: Collect SAE reconstruction error vectors for 500 prompts on GPT-2 Small. Train a linear probe on error vectors to predict task labels. Compare probe accuracy on error vectors vs. SAE-reconstructed activations.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests whether SAEs leave a safety-relevant blind spot. If error vectors carry task signal, SAE-based audits are systematically incomplete. High-impact finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pretrained SAE from SAELens, standard linear probe with sklearn, all on GPT-2 Small. Very well within beginner capability and 30hr budget.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Extremely tight: collect error vectors, train probe, compare accuracies. One model, one SAE, one clear metric.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
